unified_features.name: Slot publishing
unified_features.rationale: Only Slotty documents slot publishing; BookNow assumes slots exist. Rebuilt from docs (closed source).
unified_features.behaviour: A team member creates, edits and withdraws slots (start, end, price, capacity 1). Customers see only published, future, open slots.

unified_features.name: Card payments (Stripe)
unified_features.rationale: Only BookNow takes payment. Its charge() implementation is missing, so it is rebuilt.
unified_features.behaviour: Charges the slot price by card through Stripe (test mode in development) with an idempotency key per booking occurrence; refunds on eligible cancellation.
unified_features.improvements: Idempotency key; explicit failure handling; refunds (absent in source).

unified_features.name: Slot booking
unified_features.rationale: BookNow and Slotty both book slots; BookNow's observed behaviour was chosen over Slotty's one-line API summary (M02 dropped).
unified_features.behaviour: A customer books an open slot: the slot is held atomically, the price is charged, and the booking becomes confirmed; a taken slot is refused with 'slot taken' and nothing is charged; on payment failure the hold is released.
unified_features.improvements: Mark slots taken atomically (source never sets slot.taken); confirm only after a successful charge and release the hold on failure (source charges before insert with no rollback).

unified_features.name: Booking cancellation (24-hour rule)
unified_features.behaviour: A customer cancels a booking that starts at least 24 hours from now; later cancellations are refused with 'too late to cancel'. The booking becomes cancelled (not deleted), the slot reopens, and a 'slot freed' event is emitted.
unified_features.improvements: Soft cancel instead of hard delete; emits slot-freed for the waiting list; refund rule decided in compatibility.

unified_features.name: Recurring weekly bookings
unified_features.rationale: Only Slotty documents recurring bookings; rebuilt from docs.
unified_features.behaviour: A customer books the same weekly slot for 2 to 12 weeks as one series of individual bookings.

unified_features.name: Waiting list
unified_features.rationale: Only Slotty documents a waiting list; rebuilt from docs.
unified_features.behaviour: A customer joins the waiting list of a taken slot; when the slot is freed, waiting customers are offered it in join order.
